text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm gifting Gimlet-chan a fun day 
out~. Do you have any requests?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Are you inviting me to paradise? 
Then what I crave is fleeting ecstasy! I 
wish to taste the sweet forbidden fruit 
with my sworn ally.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A fleeting thrill...? Hmm~, in that case, 
maybe a roller coaster??

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Bungee jump—that is also an option.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Neither is bad... However, since we are 
here, I would rather cast off the shackles 
of tranquility and savor a supreme 
intoxication akin to falling from the 
heavens.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Found one—a skydiving club. —Should I book 
it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Then let us venture forth together, 
toward the azure sky that swallows all—!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm, skydiving into the perfect 
blue...—
